name: @tx-wats/alert-registry-bindings
description: TypeScript bindings for the AlertRegistry Soroban smart contract

scripts.build: CONTRACT_ID=$(python3 ../../scripts/deployment_address.py --network testnet --contract "Alert Registry") && stellar contract bindings typescript --wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/alert_registry.wasm --output-dir ./dist --contract-id "$CONTRACT_ID" --overwrite && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.entry.json

author: Tx-wats <https://github.com/Tx-wats>
